read_filters.name: AlignmentAgreesWithHeaderReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filters out reads where the alignment does not match the contents of the header

read_filters.name: AmbiguousBaseReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filters out reads that have greater than the threshold number of N bases

read_filters.name: ExcessiveEndClippedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads that have too many clipped bases on either end.

read_filters.name: FragmentLengthReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only read pairs with insert length less than or equal to the given value

read_filters.name: IntervalOverlapReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filters out reads that don't overlap the specified region. NOTE: This approach to extracting overlapping reads is very slow compared to using PrintReads and -L on an indexed bam file.

read_filters.name: JexlExpressionReadTagValueFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads that meet all given jexl expressions (on their attributes)

read_filters.name: LibraryReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads from the specified library

read_filters.name: MappingQualityReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads with mapping qualities within a specified range

read_filters.name: MateDistantReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only paired reads with mates mapped >= mate-too-distant-length (default 1KB) apart or on different contigs

read_filters.name: MetricsReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads that fail platform quality checks, are unmapped and represent secondary/supplementary alignments

read_filters.name: OverclippedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads that are over-soft-clipped

read_filters.name: PlatformReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads with matching Read Group platform

read_filters.name: PlatformUnitReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads with matching platform unit attribute

read_filters.name: AllowAllReadsReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Do not filter out any read

read_filters.name: CigarContainsNoNOperator
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads with CIGAR containing N operator

read_filters.name: FirstOfPairReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads that are first of pair

read_filters.name: GoodCigarReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads containing good CIGAR string

read_filters.name: HasReadGroupReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads without Read Group

read_filters.name: MappedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out unmapped reads

read_filters.name: MappingQualityAvailableReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads without available mapping quality

read_filters.name: MappingQualityNotZeroReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads with mapping quality equal to zero

read_filters.name: MatchingBasesAndQualsReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads where the bases and qualities do not match

read_filters.name: MateDifferentStrandReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads with mates mapped on the different strand

read_filters.name: MateOnSameContigOrNoMappedMateReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads whose mate maps to the same contig or is unmapped

read_filters.name: MateUnmappedAndUnmappedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filters reads whose mate is unmapped as well as unmapped reads.

read_filters.name: NonChimericOriginalAlignmentReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filters reads whose original alignment was chimeric.

read_filters.name: NonZeroFragmentLengthReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads with fragment length different from zero

read_filters.name: NonZeroReferenceLengthAlignmentReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads that do not align to the reference

read_filters.name: NotDuplicateReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads marked as duplicate

read_filters.name: NotProperlyPairedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only paired reads that are not properly paired

read_filters.name: NotSecondaryAlignmentReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads representing secondary alignments

read_filters.name: NotSupplementaryAlignmentReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads representing supplementary alignments

read_filters.name: PairedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out unpaired reads

read_filters.name: PassesVendorQualityCheckReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads failing platfor/vendor quality checks

read_filters.name: PrimaryLineReadFilter
read_filters.summary:
Keep only reads representing primary alignments (those that satisfy both the NotSecondaryAlignment and
 NotSupplementaryAlignment filters, or in terms of SAM flag values, must have neither of the 0x100 or
 0x800 flags set).

read_filters.name: ProperlyPairedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads that are properly paired

read_filters.name: ReadLengthEqualsCigarLengthReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads  where the read and CIGAR do not match in length

read_filters.name: SecondOfPairReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only paired reads that are second of pair

read_filters.name: SeqIsStoredReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads with sequenced bases

read_filters.name: ValidAlignmentEndReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads where the read end is properly aligned

read_filters.name: ValidAlignmentStartReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads with a valid alignment start

read_filters.name: ReadGroupBlackListReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep records that don't match the specified filter string(s).

read_filters.name: ReadGroupReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads from the specified read group

read_filters.name: ReadLengthReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads whose length is within a certain range

read_filters.name: ReadNameReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads with this read name

read_filters.name: ReadStrandFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads whose strand is as specified

read_filters.name: ReadTagValueFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads that contains a tag with value that agrees with parameters

read_filters.name: SampleReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads for a given sample

read_filters.name: SoftClippedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads that are over-soft-clipped

read_filters.name: WellformedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only reads that are well-formed

read_filters.name: FlowBasedTPAttributeSymetricReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out flow reads that have invalid TP values (non palandromic)

read_filters.name: FlowBasedTPAttributeValidReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out flow reads that have invalid TP values

read_filters.name: HmerQualitySymetricReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads that don't have palandromic hmer flow order qualities

read_filters.name: ReadGroupHasFlowOrderReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Filter out reads without a flow associated

read_filters.name: WellformedFlowBasedReadFilter
read_filters.summary: Keep only flow based reads that are well-formed
